blocks.html: Where the building drain is installed underground and within 5 feet (1524 mm) of the water service, as provided for in Section 603.2, the building drain pipe shall conform to one of the standards for, cast-iron pipe, copper or copper-alloy tubing, or ductile iron listed in Table 702.3.
